notes: All eight helper candidates audited against journal-specific official instructions and applicable publisher policy. Compatibility describes the human-led workflow within stated restrictions, not blanket approval of all AI uses.

ai_policy.summary: The journal explicitly permits research and writing assistance, including data analysis and coding help and drafting subsequently heavily revised by authors. Human oversight, understanding, verification, and responsibility are required.

disclosure.instructions: Add a Declaration of AI Use immediately before references specifying tools, purposes and scope and extent of assistance.
disclosure.section: Generative AI and AI-Assisted Technologies Policy; submission checklist

restrictions: Generated text must not exceed 12% under the submission checklist.
No primary research data, experimental results or statistical outcomes generated by AI; no unverified data or untested solely AI-produced code.
Substantial sections require significant human revision and critical input; fabricated citations and misleading output are forbidden.

policy_sources.note: Explicitly permits revised drafts, data analysis and software development assistance under author control; describes declaration.
Submission checklist sets maximum 12% AI-generated text.

patches.audit_note: Explicit drafting and analysis assistance support compatibility within substantial quantitative and human-review restrictions.

ai_policy.summary: Journal ethics describes AI use in manuscript writing and data collection and analysis under disclosure and human oversight, including content produced with AI. Human authors retain full responsibility.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose tool, version, purpose and human oversight in methods or AI declaration; fully describe AI in research design in methods. Report tool name, version, date and settings for methods; include prompts and relevant outputs when reproduced or discussed.
disclosure.section: Authorship and Artificial Intelligence Tools Policy; Use of Generative AI

restrictions: AI cannot be an author; verify all references and quotations; no fabricated data or citations.

policy_sources.note: Writing with human control and collection and analysis uses are addressed with disclosure and author responsibility.
Section 10 specifies disclosure beyond basic grammar, spelling and punctuation; sections 4 and 7 describe research-method details and prompts.

patches.audit_note: Explicit writing and data-analysis use with oversight supports the requested human-led workflow.

ai_policy.summary: AI is limited to supportive language functions; generating original research content, data, analyses, interpretations or conclusions is prohibited.

disclosure.instructions: Include a statement naming the tool, purpose and stage of manuscript preparation.

restrictions: Only supportive functions such as language editing, grammar and clarity are permitted.
AI cannot be an author; authors remain responsible for originality, accuracy and integrity.

policy_sources.note: Restricts AI to language support and expressly prohibits generating original research content and analyses.

patches.audit_note: Express language-only restriction disqualifies substantive drafting and analysis.

ai_policy.summary: Guidelines require declaration for AI used in manuscript writing and mention methodology, but do not establish permission for substantive research, analysis or drafting.

disclosure.instructions: If AI is used in manuscript writing, declare it in Methodology and Statements and declarations, naming the tool and reasons; affirm responsibility for accuracy.
disclosure.section: Declaration of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Scientific Writing

policy_sources.note: Writing-use declaration and responsibility are specified; no express substantive-use permission found.

patches.audit_note: Disclosure alone is not proof of all three permissions.

ai_policy.summary: Sage explicitly identifies literature review assistance and AI-generated or enhanced code for research as appropriate with disclosure. It addresses primary or partial generated text affecting methods, analysis, results or conclusions, subject to disclosure and verification. Human authors are responsible for accuracy.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose generated content affecting methodology, analysis, results or conclusions upon submission; appropriate research uses are disclosed in methods or acknowledgements. Routine language, grammar and structure suggestions do not require disclosure.
disclosure.section: AI generated (disclosure required); Prohibited use of AI

restrictions: AI analysis of experiences and themes is listed as inappropriate; avoid this specific qualitative analysis use.

AI tools cannot be authors; authors verify outputs and original sources.
